title: trade agreements and sustainable fisheries
core_idea: Assess whether trade agreements—and specifically fisheries-related provisions within them—affect the sustainability of marine fisheries by analyzing changes in mean trophic level using global MTL data (1950–2018) and a comprehensive dataset of environmental provisions in trade agreements (1947–2018), employing difference-in-differences combined with propensity score matching to address endogeneity.
tldr: Study investigates the impact of signing free trade agreements, and FTAs that include fisheries-related provisions, on marine fisheries sustainability using MTL data and a DID + PSM identification strategy (no results reported).
